answer: A newcomer's ripple is minted only once it locks ivory in the pool the ledge hash-assigns it to; a pool's required lock is base×m^f, m its members, f the fakes it has ever held, forfeited whole on proof. The hash, not the operator, picks the pool and the ledge mints no new pools, so splitting buys nothing: with k fakes scattered by that hash, the k-th locks about base×m^(k/P) of ivory, its own earlier fakes having compounded every pool it could land in. A newcomer to a clean pool locks base.
